metadata.title: Setup, steady-state, and amortized cost
metadata.claim_boundary: measured setup, per-order, and amortized costs at registered order counts; no extrapolation beyond the grid

research_question: How much of each architecture's measured cost arises before order processing, how much arises per complete order, and how does the measured setup cost amortize over 1, 10, or 100 orders?

deployment.G3: Runtime code activation plus market contract instantiation transactions

projection_establishment.B1: N/A: no separate non-authoritative market projection

controls.reset: fresh isolated measured namespace for each repetition
controls.setup_reuse_rule: one measured setup is reused by exactly orders_per_setup complete orders and by no other cell
controls.order_fixture_rule: each measured order uses a distinct seed-derived object, authorization nonce, order ID, and buyer slot while reusing only the cell's measured setup
controls.architecture_specific_not_applicable_pol: N/A with null value and reason; never zero

repetitions.collection_rule: all 30 measured repetitions retain latency; the first 10 seed-ordered repetitions must retain weight, fee, writes, events, and contract-specific cost where applicable

warmup_policy.namespace: isolated warmup namespace that is never reused by measured setup or order samples
warmup_policy.timing: immediately before the measured repetitions of each baseline and operation
warmup_policy.retention: retain every warmup setup and order record with sample_role=warmup
warmup_policy.summary_policy: exclude warmup records from measured setup, per-order, and amortized summaries; never delete them

amortization_rule.formula: amortized_metric = (sum(applicable measured setup_component metrics) + sum(measured per_order metrics)) / orders_per_setup
amortization_rule.precision: retain integer numerator and denominator in raw data; decimal rendering is derived only in processed output
amortization_rule.scope: calculate separately for latency_ms, completion_blocks, actual_weight_ref_time, actual_weight_proof_size, actual_fee, storage_writes, events_count, and applicable contract_gas_or_ref_time

expected_result_rules: Warmup, setup_component, per_order, and amortized records are separately labeled and never pooled as one distribution.
Every applicable setup component is measured independently; an architecture-specific absent boundary is N/A with null, not zero.
Each cell has at least 30 measured latency repetitions and at least 10 measured deterministic-cost repetitions.
Each amortized value is reproduced exactly from its captured setup and order numerator and orders_per_setup denominator.
Results are interpreted only at orders_per_setup values 1, 10, and 100; no universal scaling claim is allowed.
stop_gates: E0 or the frozen I1-I10 prerequisite gate is not PASS
warmup records are deleted, relabeled, or share the measured namespace
setup and per-order samples are mixed or one setup is reused outside its cell
an applicable setup component or required metric is missing
latency or deterministic repetition minimum is not met
an amortized value does not reproduce from its frozen numerator and denominator
a required common capability is missing
